guidance: Coming to our industry, zinc fundamentals remain strong , with 202 6 forecasted refined zinc demand is at 13.87 million tons, whereas the supply outlook is at 13.69 million tons.
However, looking at the current improvements in zinc cost of production, we are revising our COP guidance to $825 to $850 for the full year.
capex: Engineering and procurement for the 250 KTPA integrated zinc expansion is almost complete, and mine development is underway.
Generating INR6,389 crores of free cash flow before growth capex during the quarter highlights the strength of our underlying cash flows, cost competitiveness, and prudent financial management.
risks: The global business environment remains challenging amid escalating geopolitical tensions, energy and trade disruptions, changing tariff policies, and divergent regional growth trends.
Despite near -term uncertainties, the medium -term to long -term outlook for our key metals remains positive.
focus: Happy to report that we are sustaining our strong momentum in the second quarter, delivering solid operational and financial performance while we continue to focus on our strategic priorities.
Further, we are entering partnerships with different agencies to continue our ESG drive.

about: Incorporated in 1966, Hindustan Zinc in Zinc-Lead and Silver business is world’s 2nd largest integrated Zinc producer and Hindustan Zinc is the 3rd largest silver producer globally with an annual capacity of 800MT . The company has a market share of ~75% of the growing Zinc market in India with its headquarters at Zinc City, Udaipur along with Zinc-Lead mines and smelting complexes spread across the state of Rajastha
